pull.title: Migrate bounded channel state machines to sovereign Kotoba
pull.body: Replaces production CLJC with a bounded canonical-document channel state machine in Kotoba. Capacity is 1–32, invalid kinds and capacities fail closed, payloads cross a typed document boundary, and persistent put/take/close/drain behavior is verified in reference execution, restricted JavaScript, and instantiated typed Wasm. JVM remains a test/compiler host only; conformance is semantic and ABI-based, not byte identity.
